_docs.purpose: Places and organisations whose stories belong to the ward they are based in (editor, 14 Nov 2026: 'yes, home ward' for clubs, colleges and hospitals). The ward is never typed here: the pipeline looks the postcode up (postcodes.io, ONS data) and writes the answer to ward_postcode_evidence.json. A place whose postcode has not been looked up yet decides nothing.
_docs.how_to_add: Add an entry with the place's own address postcode and the names stories use for it (lower case). Check the postcode on the organisation's own website.
_docs.matching: A name counts only in the headline, standfirst or the first paragraph.
